text:
incident-bot: Pager: metering-service detected token-count jitter >10% vs baseline for EU region. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-count-drift. Paging on-call.
irene-oncall: taking this. seen spike from ~02:05 UTC, ~12% over expected. starting triage. will check emit pipeline and redis counts.
kevin-sre: ack. I'll look at kafka consumer lag + emitter retries. first quick check: `kafka.consumer.lag_total` looks normal, but emitter-retry-rate spiked at 02:06.
sam-eng: on standby for any runtime fixes (can flip emitter config or revert recent deploy).
billing-ops: seeing customer alerts for possible overage flags. no invoices posted yet but some users got warns. @tara-cs can you prep a short notice if we confirm customer-visible flags?
tara-cs: yep, I'll draft a targeted message for affected accounts once we have a tenant list. keep me updated. :+1:
irene-oncall: quick findings: emitter v2 pushed 01:58 UTC had change to batching window (-> 500ms). suspect partial double-count on edge when batching flusher raced with ack handler.
kevin-sre: reproducer logs show duplicate emit events for some requests. snippet from emitter logs:```
[02:06:12] INFO emit id=abc123 attempts=1
[02:06:12] WARN emit id=abc123 attempts=2 (duplicate ack path)
```
sam-eng: can we toggle `enable_batch_dedupe` to true and restart a single emitter shard without full rollback? That should stop new duplicates.
irene-oncall: good idea. I'll patch config on eu-emitter-3 now.
platform-nick: FYI if we restart shard we'll see a small backlog replay; ensure consumer dedupe is on. I'll coordinate.
incident-bot: Action logged: irene-oncall toggled enable_batch_dedupe on eu-emitter-3 at 02:14 UTC.
kevin-sre: after the toggle, emitter duplicate rate dropped ~95% in the next 2m. kafka lag slightly increased during restart but steady now.
billing-ops: still seeing some overage flags for a subset of tenants (approx 48 tenants). flags are from 02:05-02:12 window. No billing charges applied yet.
tara-cs: drafting message: "We detected transient usage reporting anomalies between 02:05-02:12 UTC that may have caused overage alerts. We're investigating and will remove false alerts by EOD. No invoices impacted." Will share list for review.
irene-oncall: mitigation path: 1) stop new duplicates (done), 2) start targeted backfill correction job to reconcile token counts for affected tenants (runbook step 4), 3) revoke any overage flags and mark alerts as false-positive, 4) post customer comms. I'll kick off backfill now (low-priority job) and monitor.
sam-eng: if backfill pulls from raw emitter logs, ensure we dedupe with event_id and emitter-shard id. sample dedupe SQL: ```SELECT event_id, count(1) FROM raw_emits WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20 02:05' AND '2026-03-20 02:12' GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(1)>1;```
kevin-sre: estimate backfill runtime ~18-30m for 48 tenants. I'll keep an eye on pipeline resource usage.
billing-ops: please also queue a job to clear overage flags once reconciled — we don't want customers still seeing false alerts after counts fixed.
irene-oncall: agreed. setting status: mitigation in progress. tagging owners: @kevin-sre for pipeline, @sam-eng for emitter config, @billing-ops for customer flags, @tara-cs for comms.
platform-nick: leaving note to ops: if any tenant has >25% delta after reconciliation, escalate to infra lead — possible data loss or replay.
incident-bot: Incident note appended. Severity remains P2.
kevin-sre: backfill job started at 02:20 UTC (job id bf-1929). initial sample shows duplicate dedupe removed ~1100 phantom tokens across 48 tenants so far.
billing-ops: preparing script to revoke alerts post-backfill. will run after kevin confirms completed diffs.
tara-cs: shared draft in #customer-templates for review. Lmk asap.
irene-oncall: quick customer impact summary for leadership: approx 48 tenants saw transient overage alerts between 02:05-02:12 UTC due to emitter batching race causing duplicate counts. No charges posted. Mitigation: emitter config toggle stopped duplicates, backfill job running to correct counts, alerts will be revoked after reconciliation. ETA for reconciliation ~02:50 UTC.
sam-eng: handing off to @sam-eng for next shift at 03:00 UTC — I'll be reachable for questions but need to hand on-call.
sam-eng: taking over at 03:00 UTC. I'll validate backfill results and coordinate clearing flags.
kevin-sre: backfill completed at 02:46 UTC. diffs applied: removed 1,132 duplicated tokens total; max tenant delta after fix: 3.8%.
billing-ops: ran alert revoke script at 02:52 UTC. confirmed flags cleared in dashboard.
tara-cs: sent targeted customer message at 03:05 UTC to affected tenant list. copy posted in thread.
irene-oncall: marking incident resolved for now. postmortem follow-up: schedule RTC with platform + emitter owners to review batching window semantics and add canary for emitter batching toggles.
platform-nick: noted. I'll open an RFC and assign owners.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (P2 -> resolved). Thread closed at 03:10 UTC.
